title: WATCH How Your Storm Will Pass When You Trust God In The Storm (Christian Motivation)
paragraphs: blasted sea a crew of weary Sailors found themselves trapped in a horrific storm giant waves crashed over the deck the wind roared like a beast and the sailors despaired for their lives for days on end the Tempest raged on but one night as the sailors huddled together praying for Dawn the wind slowed and the sky began to clear a Daybreak they cried tears of joy and gratitude as the first rays of sun peeked through the dissipating clouds though battered and bruised

the sailors had endured the Nightmare and now salvation Shone upon them storm had passed interesting story but before I jump into it let me just quickly say that I will also pray a powerful prayer with you so stay with us until the end to receive the blessings of this prayer now the storms of life often leave us feeling trapped and Powerless tossed about by forces beyond our control relationships fracture Health deteriorates job loss finances crumble before our eyes like those Sailors

we may wonder how much more we can endure but take heart The Tempest that batters you today will not last forever Victory is coming for you just as the dawn broke for those beleaguered Sailors your storm too shall pass God's purposes and Promises will prevail let's explore together how we can have hope and courage that better days are ahead my friends every storm has an expiration date in John 16 33 Jesus tells us plainly in this world you will have trouble

take heart I have overcome the world my friends troubles and trials will inevitably come but Jesus assures us that they are temporary engagements with God In Your Vessel you can smile at the storm this brings me to a point of question do you have Jesus In Your Vessel Jesus is our Blessed assurance and protection our storms cannot defeat us or last indefinitely because Christ has already conquered them you know the Bible often uses stories of storms to help us understand tough

times we go through think of a big storm with dark clouds strong winds and rain it can be a lot like the hard times we face in our lives but you see the Bible doesn't leave us without hope it tells us that just like the storm doesn't last forever our tough times won't last forever either there's this verse in the Bible Psalm 30 verse 5 it goes like this for his angers but for a moment his favor is for life weeping

may endure for a night but joy comes in the morning we might cry and feel sad for a little while but happiness comes back in the morning imagine when it's really dark at night but then the sun rises and brings light and warmth in the same way after our hard times good times will come again now there's a book in the Bible Ecclesiastes 3 that talks about how life has different seasons just like the weather changes from Spring to Summer to

fall and winter it says there's a time for everything like times to be happy and times to be sad my dear friends guess what both happiness and sadness are a part of life and they're Allowed by God he wants us to learn and grow from all these experiences even when we're feeling sad or going through a tough patch we can hold on to hope just like winter doesn't last forever our sad times won't either joy and happiness will find their way

back to us just like the sun rising after a long night so my friends remember that the storms in our lives are temporary they might be tough but they won't last forever the nights will soon be over better days are ahead just waiting for us to embrace them so take courage friend you may feel battered by Hurricane winds right now but your storm is time Limited in First Corinthians 10 verse 13 God promises he will not test you beyond what you

can endure he has prescribed boundaries for every trial trust that your Tempest has an expiration date known by God this too shall pass weeping endures only for a night Joy comes with the Morning Light in the midst of the storm we must keep our focus on the Lord Isaiah 26 verse 3 says you will keep him in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on you because he trusts in you when we fix our eyes on Jesus the storms of life cannot

overtake us the Raging winds and waves must bow to the voice of the one who calms the storms like Peter if we focus on the storm we may begin to sink but when we cry out Lord Save Me Jesus reaches down and lifts us up he rebukes the winds and waves saying peace be still let us keep our minds stayed on Christ even in the midst of the storm ever heard about the time when Jesus calmed a fierce storm it's a

story that reveals how much strength and Care Jesus has especially when life takes a rough turn in Mark 4 verse 30 5-41 imagine what had happened Jesus and his friends the disciples were in a boat on a large lake known as the Sea of Galilee suddenly out of nowhere a massive storm Unleashed its Fury the wind roared and the waves crashed into the boat even though the disciples were seasoned fishermen who knew the sea well fear gripped them they were convinced

their boat was about to be swallowed by the Raging Waters so they woke Jesus up from his nap he'd been sleeping in the boat anxiously they asked don't you care if we perish Jesus got up faced the tumultuous storm and spoke with an incredible Authority peace be still just like that the wind ceased its howling the waves ceased their raging and all was profoundly tranquil imagine the astonishment on the disciples faces all was calm and quiet my friends the Savior who

stilled that Mighty storm stands ready to calm the storms that rage in your life as well now let's meet another character from the Bible Daniel he's a young man who was thrown into a den of hungry Lions because he refused to stop praying to God can you imagine the fear he must have felt but here's the amazing part God sent an angel to shut the Lion's mouths and Daniel remained unharmed throughout the night this story shows that even in the midst

of life's fiercest trials God's protection and presence are with us think about it the same Jesus who silenced that tempestuous storm is here for us today he's ready to help us find peace when we're swamped by life's trials just as Daniel embraced the power of Faith even among lions let's remember to turn to Jesus in the midst of our troubles he's the one who can guide us through just like he guided his disciples on that tumultuous sea when life gets tough

hold on to this story and trust that Jesus can bring calmness to your storms too in the book of Acts mainly in Acts 9. verse 36-43 we encounter an often overlooked yet impactful figure named dorkus also known as Tabitha she was a devoted disciple in the early Christian Community of japa she was well known for her Compassionate Heart and remarkable skill in crafting garments for the needy however a storm of grief and loss struck when she fell ill and passed away

her fellow Believers devastated by her departure laid her body in an upper room but amidst this Tempest of Sorrow The Winds of Hope began to blow news reached the Believers that the Apostle Peter was nearby in Lida urgently descent for him upon arriving in Joppa Peter saw the garments Dorcas had made and heard stories of her kindness with faith and determination he entered the room where her lifeless body lay and prayed astonishingly Dorcas was brought back to life through God's miraculous

power this incredible event rippled through the community leading many to believe in Christ's resurrection power dorcas's life teaches us about compassion Community the power of Miracles and the unshakable hope of Resurrection in the midst of life's storms her story reminds us that God's grace and might can transform even the darkest moments into radiant testimonies of his love and restoration but how does this connect to you and me just as the disciples were shaken by a storm we Face storms in our

lives too these storms might not be actual weather events but they're those challenging times that make us anxious sad or overwhelmed yet the story of Jesus calming the storm reminds us that he can also bring peace to the turmoil within us just like he calmed the sea he can bring peace and comfort to our hearts think about it the same Jesus who silenced that tempestuous storm is here for us today he's ready to help us find peace when we're swamped by

life's trials just as Daniel embraced the power of Faith even among lions let's remember to turn to Jesus in the midst of our troubles he's the one who can guide us through just like he guided his disciples on that tumultuous sea when life gets tough hold on to this story and trust that Jesus can bring calmness to your storms too we all face raging storms cancer divorce bankruptcy depression friends the pain and uncertainty can seem overwhelming but take courage Jesus sees

you in the midst of the storm cry out to him in faith asking him to silence the wind and still the waves in your soul expect our compassionate savior to speak words of Courage Authority and peace over your personal storm for though the Tempest thrashes they must obey and be still by the one who rules over wind and wave call Upon Jesus Christ The Prince of Peace to calm your storm though the storms rage we can have hope through faith in

Christ the Bible reminds us in Hebrews 6 19. we have this hope as an anchor for the soul firm and secure dear friends Jesus is the anchor that keeps our souls steady When Storms toss us to and fro he Jesus entered the Ultimate Storm of God's Wrath on the cross so that we could have peace with God Our Hope in him gives us stability and courage to endure Earthly storms as First Peter 1 6-7 explains in this you greatly Rejoice though

now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in all kinds of Trials these have come so that your faith of Greater worth than gold which perishes even though refined by fire maybe proved genuine and may result in Praise my dear friends I urge you to let Christ your hope anchor you firmly so you do not despair your storm will pass God has not forsaken you he remains with you in the storm in Acts 27 verse 23 to

24 the Apostle Paul faced a horrific storm at sea after days of helpless drift an angel appeared telling Paul he would survive because God had a plan for him in Rome Paul took courage knowing god was watching over him even allowing the storm for divine purposes my friend's God is not done with you you will survive emerging stronger with faith stronger than steel like Paul you are never alone in life's tempests God promises in Hebrews 13 Verse 5 I will never

leave you nor forsake you the Holy Spirit your comforter encourages you in the gale force wins listen and hear that still Small Voice in Matthew 28 verse 20 Jesus assures us he is always with us even to the End of the Age We Are reminded in Psalm 46 verse 1 God is our refuge and strength and ever-present help in times of trouble you have a shelter in the midst of the battering winds and rain God upholds you with his righteous right

hand acts 16 verse 31 believe on the Lord Jesus Christ and you will be saved you and your household so stand unafraid amidst the squall fix your eyes on Jesus let him be your lighthouse in the storm guiding you safely home storms will come but we must keep an eternal perspective Paul says in second Corinthians 4 verse 17 for our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all the storms of this life are

temporary but the glory of Heaven is eternal let us not lose heart Jesus endured the Ultimate Storm of God's Wrath on the cross so that we could have eternal life with him he shed his blood to redeem us from the storms of judgment we deserve because of sin keeping our focus on the Eternal prize empowers us to endure Earthly storms with courage and Hope the storm will pass but Heaven's Glory awaits all who put their trust in Christ as Believers we

never face the storms alone the body of Christ surrounds us with support during seasons of hardship and trial Galatians 6 verse 2 instructs us to carry each other's burdens and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ we are called to come around fellow Believers experiencing storms mourning with those who mourn weeping with those who weep friends we can provide meals Child Care Transportation and other practical helps to lighten their load our prayers make a mighty difference bringing God's

peace and strength words of encouragement and biblical counsel renew their hope the family of God uplifts and upholds those battered by storms You Are Not Alone let us bear one another's burdens my friends the storms of life are inevitable and often intense that we can have hope knowing they are temporary troubles God limits every trial and Promises Joy comes in the new day call Upon Jesus to calm your storm and speak his peace to the howling winds and waves know that

you are never alone God remains sovereignly by your side through it all the body of Christ surrounds you with support and encouragement look to the eternal glory that awaits not the momentary storms you face and now you can sing boldly without fear through it all I've learned to trust in Jesus I've learned to trust in God he will carry you through the Tempest to the other side your storm will pass salvation will shine upon you courageous Sailors of Christ believe this

promise and endure brighter days are coming your storm cannot defeat you Victory awaits God is with you now to all those within the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us pray to our gracious and loving God Heavenly Father you are Almighty and perfect in all your ways you are alpha and omega first and the last

the beginning and the ending Lord I come before you with Thanksgiving and praise I thank you for your Saving Grace and mercies merciful father have mercy upon me according to the multitude of your Tender Mercies and loving kindness Forgive Me Lord from all my trespasses forgive me for all the time that I doubted loving father fill me with your Holy Spirit search me and see if there be any doubt or sin in me Lord wash me and Purge me from all

unrighteousness renew my heart and mind to be steadfast in faith and to embrace your love knowing that you will never leave me nor forsake me Mighty God I thank you for being the anchor and shield in every storms that I face Lord you are my salvation and my very present help in times of trouble today I reaffirm my trust in Your Divine timing and purpose in the name of Jesus I bind every spirit of fear and despair I bind every Spirit

of animosity I bind every Spirit of sickness I bind every Spirit of deception I bind every generational curse I renounce and bind every Spirit of perversion I bind every Spirit of lack in the name of Jesus I declare Victory and peace in my life I declare victory over every storm that I face I declare peace and love in my family I declare healing in my body I declare breakthrough in all aspects of my life Lord let your Holy Spirit lead me

to pursue your wisdom ensuring I walk in harmony with your divine plan Lord help me to continually embrace your word and draw closer to you cherishing every moment and learning from Every Storm father I pray for my loved ones that they too May embrace your guidance and follow your word may you help them to come to know you more and to walk in your love favor and Grace Lord as I say this prayer together with everyone listening I pray that we

will recognize your presence know your love and be reassured by your promises Lord let every word resonate in our spirits and every declaration manifests in our lives as we go about this day let us walk confidently knowing that you are always by our side and that your timing is perfect Lord thank you for hearing and answering my prayer in the name of Jesus I pray amen if you were blessed by this message type the word amen in the comment section below

I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of Jesus you can help us to reach more persons and spread the gospel you can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member who you know needs the blessing of this prayer and by clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the channel for more videos that will bless your heart and uplift your spirit we appreciate all those who support us

you're blessed to be a blessing please feel free to leave your prayer requests in the comments section so that we can present them before God for your blessings and victory also we invite other believers on the YouTube platform and all over the world to join us and start praying for you right now and we want you to know that even if you don't see a reply to your prayer request it doesn't mean that you were not prayed for rest assured that

we are actively lifting up each request to God that is according to his will we believe in the power of prayer to bring Comfort healing and guidance in accordance with God's perfect plan stand in faith with us while we pray to God be all the glory May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all thank you
